mapper.select: SELECT a.task_id taskId,a.flight_route_id flightRouteId,a.warning_type_id warningTypeId,a.tenant_id tenantId, a.industry_code industryCode,a.access_node accessNode,a.accept_node acceptNode, p.device_code deviceCode FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_plan_t p ON t.plan_id = p.plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_air_algorithm_t a ON p.flight_route_id = a.flight_route_id WHERE t.flight_route_id = #{floutId} and a.algorithm_type = '2' and a.status = '0' and a.delete_flag = '0'

SELECT a.task_id taskId,a.flight_route_id flightRouteId,a.warning_type_id warningTypeId,a.tenant_id tenantId, a.industry_code industryCode,a.access_node accessNode,a.accept_node acceptNode, p.device_code deviceCode FROM vm_air_task_t t LEFT JOIN vm_air_plan_t p ON t.plan_id = p.plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_air_algorithm_t a ON p.flight_route_id = a.flight_route_id WHERE t.flight_route_id = #{floutId} and a.algorithm_type = '1' and a.status = '1' and a.delete_flag = '0' and recovery_flag = '1'
mapper.update: update vm_air_algorithm_t set delete_flag = '1',update_time =now(),update_user = 'admin' where flight_route_id = #{floutId} and algorithm_type = '2'
mapper.select: select flight_route_id from vm_air_task_t where plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} and delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: update vm_air_algorithm_t set update_time =now(),update_user = 'admin',recovery_flag = '0',status = '0' where algorithm_type = '1' and flight_route_id = #{floutId} and delete_flag = 0
mapper.select: select device_code as deviceCode ,device_name as deviceName from vm_uav_device_info_t where uav_nest_code = #{deviceCode} and delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: update vm_air_contact_alarm_t set delete_flag = 1 where device_code = #{deviceCode}

select original_Task_Record_Id as originalTaskRecordId from vm_air_refly_task_ref where task_record_id = #{taskRecordId}

select ct.longitude as lng, ct.latitude as lat, ct.algorithm_code as algorithmCode, ct.compareStrategy, ct.execution_start_Date as executionStartDate, ct.execution_end_Date as executionEndDate, ct.compareDate, ct.flight_route_id as flightRouteId, ct.id as id from vm_air_task_t t left join vm_air_line_compare_photo_t ct on t.flight_route_id = ct.flight_route_id where t.delete_flag = 0 and t.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} and ct.delete_flag = 0 and not exists ( select compare_id from vm_air_line_compare_task_t where compare_task_record_id = #{taskRecordId} and delete_flag = 0 and compare_id = ct.id )

mapper.select: select a.plan_task_id as taskRecordId from vm_air_task_t a inner join vm_air_task_t b on b.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} where a.delete_flag = 0 and a.reality_time like concat('%', #{lastCycleDate}, '%') and a.task_status = 1 and a.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and a.industry_code = b.industry_code and a.snapshot_id = b.snapshot_id order by a.reality_time desc limit 1

select task_record_id from vm_air_line_compare_task_t ct left join vm_air_task_t t on ct.compare_task_record_id = t.plan_task_id collate utf8mb4_general_ci where t.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and t.reality_time like concat('%', #{todayStr}, '%')

SELECT lp.longitude,lp.latitude,lp.algorithm_code as algorithmCodes,t.access_node as accessNode,t.plan_task_id as taskRecordId,t.flight_route_id as flightRouteId, lt.device_code as deviceCode FROM vm_air_task_t t left join vm_air_line_t lt on t.flight_route_id = lt. flight_route_id left join vm_air_line_point_info lp on lt.flight_route_id = lp.flight_route_id where t.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} and lp.algorithm_code is not null
